summary: DeepSeek released an experimental multimodal variant of V4-Flash (V4-Flash-Vision-Exp) on its API platform along with a new Files API for image uploads.

practices.reason: The model adds multimodal capability with a lab-reported large gain on multimodal agent benchmarks, but the claim is experimental and unreplicated with no named benchmark or figure.
practices.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash, bringing multimodal agent performance close to Opus-4.8.

practices.reason: Teams wanting multimodal input must switch the model identifier and adopt the new image tokenization and Files API mechanics for billing and request construction.
practices.quote: Images are tokenized for billing: up to 384 tokens each, at V4-Flash pricing
